title: Searching track, no or t never finds a part by its tracking
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, whose part number, description and tags contain no letter t and never the letters no side by side, so none of the searches below can match it by its text.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, whose description contains TRACKBAR.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, whose description contains NOZZLE.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with ZZ, so a Part Number sort from Z to A lists them at the top of the results.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type track in the Search box.
  2. Click the Part Number column header until the arrow sorts it from Z to A.
  3. Replace the search text with no.
  4. Replace the search text with t.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the parts that match track.

Step 2:

  • Part B is listed (TRACKBAR matches).
  • Part A is not listed, although it is untracked, and part C is not listed.

Step 3:

  • Part C is listed (NOZZLE matches).
  • Part A is not listed, and part B is not listed.

Step 4:

  • Part B is listed (its description has a t).
  • Part A is not listed: a single letter never finds a part by its tracking.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S6-R2: “Any other term, including part of those words such as "t" or "track", matches on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields, never on tracking state.”
